name: Touhou Under the Moonlight Music Pack
description_html:
WARNING: DUE TO GOOGLE DRIVE DELETING FILES WHEN UNZIPPED DOWNLOAD BOBBY’s MUSIC PLAYER FIRST AND THEN THIS MOD. MOVE ONLY THE AUDIO FILES NOT THE DLL. ALT SOLUTION: Download the ZIP files from my link in Bobby’s Mod Page and then unzip them to a folder or desktop

Mod adds Music from Touhou Under the Moonlight or it’s JP name, Touhou Motto Fushigi no Gensyoko. It’s apart of a series called Touhou Chronicles or as some people may know it as: Genso Wanderer Reloaded etc. anyway, felt the need to explain where it’s from.

Install: Drag BepinEx Folder into SPT directory

This is a submod for Bobby’s Main menu Replacer mod. as such it requires it.

Preview: https://youtu.be/38xyFTk3FhM?si=50z4OjxpC2VFm6zN

Updated to SPT 3.11 version
